thread:
elena (CEO): Thanks everyone for joining today. Quick follow-up on a few finance questions that came up — i'll hand to Mark for specifics. Please drop any Qs here and we'll respond live.

mark (CFO): Quick thread on runway & spend controls. High-level: burn ~ $6.5M/month right now, runway ~14 months on base assumptions. We're tracking three scenarios (base, hiring-freeze, tightened-ops). Key levers: hiring cadence, Dedicated bookings, and infra optimizations. I uploaded the model.

devin (Product): Mark — can you say which scenario assumes a hiring pause vs partial hiring?

mark (CFO): Scenario A (base) = hiring at ~60% of planned hires. Scenario B = hiring freeze for next 2 quarters. Scenario C = targeted reductions (~8% savings across comp/ops). I will post the assumptions tab shortly.

sara (VP Finance): Live sheet: https://go.red/runway-model — see 'Assumptions' + 'Sensitivity' tabs. Note: Q3 Dedicated renewals are not baked into base unless contracts signed.

jules (Eng): Are there immediate spend controls? e.g., vendor renewals > $50k needing sign-off?

maya (FinOps): Effective now: vendor contracts > $100k require Exec sign-off; $25k–$100k require FinOps review and written justification. Travel & conferences require manager + People Ops pre-approval. Procurement playbook will be posted in ~30 mins.

lisa (People Ops): Clarify hiring freeze scope — does it apply to both IC and manager reqs?

mark (CFO): Freeze is org-wide by default. Exceptions evaluated by ELT; critical roles (infra, security, customer-facing) may be exempted. Submit exceptions via the hiring-requests form: https://forms.red/hiring-requests (include exec sponsor).

devin (Product): How does this impact Dedicated capacity and capex plans?

mark (CFO): We're prioritizing existing customer commitments. New large Dedicated investments will be evaluated case-by-case; no blanket capex halt yet, but tighter scrutiny.

jules (Eng): Any immediate guidance on cloud infra (instance types / autoscaling / reserved instances)?

sara (VP Finance): Ask teams to tag all infra spend with 'team' and 'project' labels in cloud billing. FinOps will run a tag-quality scan this week and recommend quick wins (reserved instances, size downsizing, idle cleanup). We'll share a short prioritized checklist.

ops-bot: Notes uploaded to #all-hands: https://workspace.redwood/notes/1719102468 (automated).

devin (Product): Procurement SLA question: for purchases > $25k, what's the FinOps review SLA?

maya (FinOps): Standard SLA 5 business days. If urgent, use the 'expedite' flag and add your exec sponsor; we'll triage.

jules (Eng): Any change to p-card / corporate card limits?

maya (FinOps): P-card single-transaction limit lowered to $5k unless pre-approved by FinOps. Receipts must be uploaded within 3 business days. Non-compliance will lead to revocation.

sam (Support): Are customer credits / refunds still ok this quarter? We had a few big cases.

mark (CFO): Customer credits handled case-by-case. We've allocated a $200k discretionary fund for Q2 refunds/credits; escalate to finance + your CS lead for anything above $10k.

sara (VP Finance): Procurement playbook will include: approval matrix, templates (SOW, PO), and a vendor-risk checklist. We'll also publish a short video walkthrough.

devin (Product): Will you publish headcount targets by org?

elena (CEO): We'll share an updated hiring plan in Slack and the all-hands repo later today. We intend to be transparent but ask teams to avoid external sharing until the doc is published.

jules (Eng): Request: can we get per-team spend dashboards in Console?

sara (VP Finance): Yes — Cost Explorer shows per-team spend. We'll roll out a beta to Eng/Product next week; expect daily cost emails for owners.

devin (Product): Thanks — i'll coordinate with FinOps on tagging.

mark (CFO): Final quick notes: runway is healthy but not infinite. Expect tighter procurement, faster FinOps cycles, and hiring scrutiny. We want to avoid panic cuts — discipline + clarity. Keep the questions coming here or DM me. AMA. :thumbsup:

elena (CEO): Thanks Mark + Finance team. Appreciate the concrete steps. If you raised a question in the all-hands, we'll follow up directly on any outstanding items.

lisa (People Ops): We'll update the hiring FAQs and link from the hiring form.

jules (Eng): Appreciate the fast answers. One follow-up: will infra optimization recommendations be mandatory or advisory?

sara (VP Finance): Initially advisory with recommended timelines; high-impact items (e.g., mis-tagged prod infra) will be mandatory to fix within 7 days.

mark (CFO): Thanks all — closing thread for now but will check back in after Q&A doc is posted.

ops-bot: Thread closed by mark (CFO).
